prompt: Create a reusable agent skill that turns bug reports into QA test plans.
rationale: Requests creation of an agent skill, rather than the QA plan itself.

prompt: Audit this SKILL.md package for instruction quality and release readiness. Report findings only.
rationale: Requests a semantic audit of an existing skill package.

prompt: Our team repeats the same incident triage steps. Help package that procedure so an agent can reuse it.
rationale: Describes reuse of an agent procedure without naming the skill format.

prompt: Review this agent capability folder: its scripts, references, discovery metadata, and trust boundaries.
rationale: Requests review of packaged agent instructions and supporting resources.

prompt: When building an agent skill, which steps should become code instead of more instructions?
rationale: Asks a skill-authoring design question about deterministic resources.

prompt: Will this reusable skill work on Codex and Claude Code? Compare what needs adapting.
rationale: Requests a host-portability assessment of an agent skill.

prompt: Write a QA test plan for the attached checkout bug.
rationale: Requests the domain task itself; no agent-skill authoring or audit.

prompt: Review this Python API implementation for bugs.
rationale: Requests ordinary code review, not skill-package review.

prompt: Explain how Python loads a module from another directory.
rationale: Asks a general programming question outside skill design.

prompt: Add better exception handling to this command-line script.
rationale: Requests an ordinary script repair without skill context.

prompt: Do not use skill-builder. Explain YAML folded strings directly.
rationale: Explicitly opts out even though YAML overlaps skill-authoring terminology.

prompt: Improve this developer's resume skills section.
rationale: Uses the ordinary-language sense of skills, unrelated to agent capabilities.

prompt: hey can u make a SKILL.md for checking local csv reports? no publishing
rationale: Requests a new skill using casual phrasing and a publication exclusion.

prompt: Before sharing this agent instruction bundle, check whether its claims and evidence hold up.
rationale: Requests evidence and readiness assessment of an agent instruction bundle.

prompt: We keep re-explaining this workflow to our coding agent. Make it a reusable, testable capability.
rationale: Describes repeated agent workflow packaging without SKILL.md terminology.

prompt: How can I tell whether my skill description gets selected for the right requests?
rationale: Asks how to evaluate a skill's discovery description.

prompt: Compare these two OpenAPI files for breaking changes.
rationale: Requests API contract review rather than authoring or auditing its agent skill.

prompt: Package my Python library as a wheel.
rationale: Requests Python distribution packaging, not skill distribution.

prompt: Summarize the documentation attached to this ticket.
rationale: Requests an ordinary document summary; documents are input data.

prompt: Write a short release checklist for our web application.
rationale: Requests an application release checklist, not a skill-building workflow.
